Tears of Steel, Blender Foundation / Mango Open Movie Project (2012). Official files https://download.blender.org/demo/movies/ToS/ . Specific M&E file TOS_MUSIC+FX_NO_DIALOGUE.aif. IMPORTANT: directory copyright.txt explicitly covers Original Soundtrack under CC BY-ND 3.0; it must NOT be generalized to all film assets. Local research package; asset-specific adaptation/redistribution confirmation remains required before external publication.

本包仅在用户指定本地目录构建；未对外发布。素材署名/许可不因任务困难而省略。


Additional optional offline tool: F5-TTS 1.1.10 (https://github.com/SWivid/F5-TTS), F5TTS_v1_Base model_1250000 (https://huggingface.co/SWivid/F5-TTS, model license CC-BY-NC-4.0), Vocos mel24khz (https://huggingface.co/charactr/vocos-mel-24khz). Generic model weights, not task answers. Local inference package omits Trainer eager import and defers unused BigVGAN librosa import; Vocos inference math unchanged. CPU only.
